pages.text: Sends a HEAD request: like GET, but the answer has no data.$(br2)$(1)result$() holds the headers of the answer as a JSON object instead, with lower-case names in alphabetical order, like $(1){"content-length":"12"}$().

$(li)$(1)connection$() STRUCT c0de_net/http/HTTP_CONNECTION: the server$(li)$(1)endpoint$() STRING: the path behind the base endpoint (optional, default empty)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the headers as JSON$(li)result $(1)status$() INTEGER: the HTTP status
$(li)result $(1)headers$() HASH STRING: the headers of the answer
$(1)CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_HEAD$(br)  PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  PARAMETER endpoint "/status" ;$(br)  RESULT status status$()
